title: Set a 1 gwei EVM gas floor and disable the staking precompile
summary:
Two security and economics fixes, no binary change and no halt.

1. Feemarket: min_gas_price and base_fee set to 1 gwei (1000000000 asteem per gas). The floor was 0, so the EIP-1559 base fee had decayed to zero and EVM transactions paid no fees, which meant the 25% fee burn burned nothing. 1 gwei matches the default gas price every validator node and all three oracle clients already use, so price-feed transactions keep working.

2. EVM: remove the staking precompile (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000800) from active_static_precompiles. It let any EVM account call createValidator/editValidator directly, bypassing the requirement that every validator holds an ACTIVE Steem name and publishes its Steem public keys. Staking itself is unaffected and remains available through normal Cosmos transactions. No validator has used this route.
